assertions.title: Provider-aware file search stays pinned to the originating provider

steps.action: Enable File Search in compose tools and upload r3-files-note.txt via Upload for File Search
steps.expected: Upload is embedded through provider-matched local RAG and file metadata persists originating provider
steps.observed: Upload succeeded but stored record used metadata.nativeTool=file_search without ragProvider/ragModel metadata.

steps.action: Send a follow-up file-search query and inspect conversation/file metadata
steps.expected: Follow-up query reuses provider-pinned backend and conversation/file metadata reflects tracked file usage
steps.observed: Conversation metadata returned files_count=0 and response did not reflect expected uploaded-file context path.

assertions.issues: Observed metadata did not persist local-RAG provider pinning (ragProvider/ragModel), so contract behavior was not confirmed.

assertions.title: Context-mode screenshots preserve both vision input and OCR text

steps.action: Switch to context mode (File Search off), choose Upload as Text, upload r3-ocr-text.png
steps.expected: Image preview remains available for vision-capable handling and OCR text is stored/injected as text context
steps.observed: Image preview remained available (View r3-ocr-text.png), but text-context response surfaced raw PNG binary bytes instead of OCR text extraction.

steps.action: Ask model to read uploaded image text
steps.expected: Model receives OCR text context (readable extracted text)
steps.observed: Response began with binary PNG payload bytes, indicating failed OCR-text extraction in context mode.

evidence.network: GET /api/files -> 200 (VAL-FILES-002-api-files-headers.txt, VAL-FILES-002-api-files-body.json); response payload evidence in VAL-FILES-002-page-text-upload-as-text-response-final.txt

assertions.issues: Context-mode Upload-as-Text path produced binary dump instead of OCR text, so OCR-preservation contract failed.

assertions.title: Native OpenAI, Azure, and Gemini tool routing keeps LibreChat file bookkeeping intact

steps.action: Exercise OpenAI file-search upload path and inspect file metadata
steps.expected: Native routing keeps coherent file bookkeeping without duplicate/mixed ingestion
steps.observed: OpenAI file-search record with metadata.nativeTool=file_search was observed, but full no-duplicate bookkeeping guarantees could not be conclusively proven from this run.

steps.expected: Validate equivalent native-routing bookkeeping across OpenAI, Azure, and Gemini
steps.observed: Blocked by credential prerequisites: Azure configured as user_provided without executable user key path in this run; Google runtime key path unavailable/invalid in logs.

evidence.network: Provider env snapshot: VAL-FILES-003-provider-env-snapshot.txt; OpenAI file metadata: VAL-FILES-001-api-files-after-attempt2.json; Google runtime 400s visible in VAL-FILES-005-api-log-context.txt

assertions.issues: Cross-provider native-routing verification remained blocked by Azure/Google credential prerequisites in this environment partition.

assertions.title: Audio and video transcription is an explicit compose-bar action that creates a dedicated transcript conversation

steps.action: Upload audio file in compose bar on /c/new
steps.expected: Transcribe controls become visible and user can explicitly trigger Transcribe from compose bar
steps.observed: Audio attachment chip appeared, but no Transcribe control surfaced in compose UI.

steps.action: Call POST /api/files/transcribe for the uploaded file
steps.expected: Dedicated transcript conversation with user request + non-error transcribing placeholder
steps.observed: API returned 200 and created transcript conversation/messages (request + processing placeholder), but this was only achievable via API fallback because compose-bar Transcribe action was missing.

assertions.issues: Required explicit compose-bar Transcribe action did not appear after audio upload.

assertions.title: Background transcription shows progress, completion, and failure in place

steps.action: Queue transcription job and poll message status
steps.expected: Placeholder updates in place through processing/completed/failed lifecycle with explicit metadata
steps.observed: Processing -> failed transition was observed in-place with explicit failure text, but newly queued upload failed due missing temp-file path (ENOENT).

steps.expected: Completed status and completed transcript text are visible in transcript conversation
steps.observed: Existing transcript conversation for silence.mp3 showed completed status, but current new-job path still failed and did not provide healthy progress/completion behavior for this retest batch.

evidence.network: POST /api/files/transcribe -> 200 (VAL-FILES-004-transcribe-api-headers.txt); poll shows failed status + ENOENT (VAL-FILES-005-transcription-status-poll.txt); completed reference conversation messages in VAL-FILES-005-silence-messages.json

assertions.issues: New transcription job failed with ENOENT (/app/uploads/temp/... missing), so reliable progress/completion lifecycle for newly uploaded media did not hold.

assertions.title: Diarization mode supports named speaker clips and disables prompts where unsupported

steps.action: Select GPT-4o Diarize in Speech -> Advanced
steps.expected: Prompt editing is disabled for diarization model
steps.observed: Prompt field became disabled (is enabled = false).

steps.expected: Reject non-audio, reject <2s and >10s clips, accept valid 2-10s clips

steps.action: Submit diarization transcription request with 5 speaker references
steps.expected: At most 4 named references persisted, diarization workflow remains conversation-consistent with speaker-labeled output
steps.observed: Speaker references were truncated to 4, but API returned conversation save error and conversation lookup returned 404; transcript output for tested clip was 'No speech was detected' (no speaker-labeled lines).

evidence.network: Prompt disabled probe: VAL-FILES-006-prompt-enabled-state.txt; transcription-reference responses: VAL-FILES-006-transcription-reference-*-typed-headers.txt/body.json; diarize transcribe request: VAL-FILES-006-diarize-transcribe-headers.txt/body.json; convo lookup: VAL-FILES-006-diarize-convo-headers.txt (404); message status: VAL-FILES-006-diarize-messages.json

assertions.issues: Diarization constraints partially worked, but request returned conversation-save error and final speaker-labeled transcript rendering could not be confirmed.

blockers.description: Cross-provider native-routing validation is credential-gated in this isolated dev run.
blockers.quickFixAttempted: Captured env state (AZURE_API_KEY=user_provided, AZURE_OPENAI_BASEURL=user_provided, GOOGLE_KEY empty) and attempted OpenAI-only path; Azure/Gemini executable paths remained unavailable.

summary: Tested 6 assigned assertions on dev rail: 0 passed, 5 failed (VAL-FILES-001,002,004,005,006), 1 blocked (VAL-FILES-003). Core failures were missing compose-bar Transcribe control, OCR context-mode binary text leakage, and transcription reliability issues (ENOENT and diarize conversation-save error).
